_meta.purpose: Bibliographic register. Every rule in this library carries source keys that resolve here, so any number the platform shows can be cited properly in a paper, a drawing note or a client report.
_meta.how_to_cite: Dimensional facts are not copyrightable and citing them is normal scholarly practice. What this repository does NOT do is reproduce the reference works themselves — no scanned pages, no redrawn figures, no wholesale transcription of a table's selection and arrangement. Values are recorded as facts with a page pointer so a reader can verify them in their own copy.
_meta.verification_note: A record carrying `neufert_ref` has been checked against the page cited. A record without one is seeded from the regulatory sources and is still to be verified.

neufert4.full: Neufert, E. and Neufert, P. (2000) Architects' Data. 3rd English edition (4th German edition). Oxford: Blackwell Science.
neufert4.note: Page numbers refer to the PRINTED page number shown on the page, not the PDF index. The offset in the scanned copy on this machine is +13 (PDF page 36 carries printed page 23).
